# automox_needs_attention_report (Data Source)

Automox's needs-attention report: non-compliant devices, with the policies they are failing and why.

This describes the fleet at a moment, not configuration. Referring to it from a resource argument makes that resource change whenever the fleet does.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `critical` (Number)
- `devices` (Attributes List) Devices Automox reports as needing attention. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `high` (Number)
- `low` (Number)
- `medium` (Number)
- `no_known_cves` (Number) Devices whose outstanding patches carry no known CVEs.
- `none` (Number)
- `total` (Number) Devices covered by the report.
- `unknown` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `compliant` (Boolean)
- `connected` (Boolean)
- `custom_name` (String)
- `disconnected_thirty_days` (Boolean)
- `group_id` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_compatible` (Boolean) False when the Automox agent cannot manage this device.
- `last_refresh_time` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `needs_reboot` (Boolean)
- `os_family` (String)
- `policies` (Attributes List) The policies this device is failing, and why. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--devices--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.policies`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `reason_for_fail` (String) Automox's stated reason the device is non-compliant.
- `severity` (String)
- `type` (String)
